name: Stacked colour-panel wipe

source.description: 1 inspected reference film (batch-5, 2026-11-27): a flat brand-colour course launch changes section with two colour panels sliding in from the same side, the second becoming the next background.

technique: Two flat colour panels slide across from the same side one after the other: the first covers the outgoing scene, the second follows over it and stays as the next scene's background. The double pass reads as a deliberate brand gesture and hands over the next section's colour.
purpose: Turn a section change into a brand gesture and hand over the next section's colour in the same move.
visual_behaviour: An accent panel slides across and covers the frame, holds a beat, then a second panel in the next background colour slides over it from the same side and stays; the new content builds on it. A single-panel version crosses once.
mechanics: Panel 1 (accent colour) enters from the left with a fast ease-out to full cover in about 0.13 s, holds about 0.15 s, panel 2 (the next background colour) enters from the same side in about 0.22 s; new content starts after panel 2 lands. Single-panel variant: one panel crosses in about 0.25 s.

decomposition.timing: Whole gesture about 0.5 s (8.95-9.47 s); single panel about 0.25 s (36.45-36.70 s); used twice in 40 s.

use_cases: Section changes in flat brand-colour films
Moving into a dark logo section
failure_modes: Panel colours not used elsewhere read as a glitch
Slower than about 0.6 s it feels like a curtain
At every section it becomes a tic

implementation.approach: Two full-frame panels on an overlay layer: panel 1 x from -100% to 0 in about 0.13 s (power3.out), hold about 0.15 s, panel 2 from -100% to 0 in about 0.22 s, then Studio.cut to the incoming scene whose background is panel 2's colour and hide both panels. Studio.fx.push moves scenes, not panels, so this is a small custom overlay; Studio.fx.shapeCover with square: true is the nearest built cover. Not built as a preset.

requirements: the incoming background in panel 2's colour

provenance.observed: A yellow panel covers from the left in 0.13 s, holds, a navy panel follows in 0.22 s and becomes the logo scene (8.95-9.47 s); a blue panel crosses the yellow scene (36.45-36.70 s).

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown).
